title: Stanford Professor Andrei Linde celebrates physics breakthrough
summary: A short Stanford video in which Chao-Lin Kuo surprises Professor Andrei Linde with BICEP2 evidence supporting cosmic inflation, the first apparent images of primordial gravitational waves.
why: Shared for its moving moment of scientific discovery, and later cited as a cautionary example after the BICEP2 result was retracted.

quote.text: They made a nice video of the researcher surprising Prof Linde with the news
